name: create-metonia-admin
description: Generate native, agent-friendly SvelteKit admin applications.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/bin.ts --bundle --outfile ./dist/create-metonia-admin.js --target node --format esm --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node ./scripts/copy-runtime-assets.mjs
